vb_textbox.text: There are two pairs of colours, I had Purple / Brown and Pink / grey. The aim is to select one of each pair and based on the amount of mushrooms recieved you can then infer which gnome will give you the most amount of mushrooms. So if you were to select Purple and it gave you a small amount of mushrooms e.g. 1-4 then you should select the opposite colour in the next round for example brown. If you were to get 5+ then you should continue selecting the same colour until until the amount of mushrooms you get drops under your personal threshold, mine was over or under 4 at this point I would change my selection until one of the pairings gave me more than 4 then I would continue selecting that option until it went under my threshold. Something I did notice however, was that two of the pairings seemed to be linked e.g. when Purple(group1) was giving me the most mushrooms then Pink(group2) was also giving me the most. When either Pink or Purple started giving me less mushrooms i knew it was time to swap to the alternate choice for both groups.
